# sspi_ldap_identity_sources (Data Source)

Lists every LDAP identity source configured on the SSPI appliance.

Corresponds to `GET /sspi/iam/ldap-identity-sources`. Returns all results in a single page (no offset/page_size pass-through).

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) The LDAP identity sources configured on the SSPI appliance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>

### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `base_distinguished_name` (String) Base DN searched for users and groups.
- `domain_name` (String) Authentication domain suffix routed to this identity source.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the LDAP identity source.
- `ldap_type` (String) LDAP server implementation (`ACTIVE_DIRECTORY` or `OPEN_LDAP`).
